resources.string: See your alerts on this TV
On your phone or computer, open this address, sign in and approve this TV:
Or in ViktorychApp: Settings › My devices › Link a TV, then enter the code.
This links Alerts and Cast on this TV to your account. Alerts checks for new alerts while it is on screen and stops when you leave. Turn both off in Make ViktorychTV your default to sign the TV out.
That account turned this TV down. Try again with a new code.
Can\'t reach ViktorychApp right now. Trying again soon.
Too many tries. Waiting a moment.
Messages, mentions and Live alerts from your account in one panel, opened from the home screen. Link it once with a code; it only checks while it is on screen.
Next: open Alerts and link this TV
Sign this TV out of Alerts
Cast from your phone to this TV
This links Cast and Alerts on this TV to your account. Cast only checks for links while this screen is open. Turn both off in Make ViktorychTV your default to sign the TV out.
On your phone, open ViktorychApp › Settings › Send to my TV. Paste a post, video or song link and choose Send to my TV app. It opens here.
Waiting for a link from your phone…
This TV only opens ViktorychApp, YouTube, X, Twitch and media links, so it skipped a link from %1$s.
Nothing on this TV can play that link. Turn on Video and music links in Make ViktorychTV your default.
Paused after 30 minutes without a cast, to save data.
Casting goes through your own account and our free server, with no Chromecast. Nothing runs when this screen is closed.
Send posts, videos and songs from your phone to this TV through your own account. It checks for a cast only while the Cast screen is open.
